seo.metaTitle: Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Services | Linkfields Innovations
seo.metaDescription: Run connected ERP and CRM platforms with Linkfields: SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho, Salesforce, Linkworks and platform migration & AMS.
seo.keywords: ERP, CRM, SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho, Salesforce, platform AMS

sections.heading: Connected platforms at the core of your enterprise
sections.body:
Run the core of the enterprise on connected ERP and CRM platforms, made smarter with AI.

From implementation, upgrades and migration to managed support and optimisation, we connect finance, operations and customer engagement. Self-service and partner portals extend those journeys beyond the organisation.

sections.heading: Run the core of the enterprise, *made smarter with AI*
Operate, integrate and engage with confidence
sections.body: Choose the platform that fits your business, then connect it to the people, processes and data that make it work.

cards.title: SAP S/4HANA
cards.description: ERP implementation, upgrades and migration. Navigate the move from legacy transactions to future-ready practices, with a roadmap for your SAP S/4HANA journey.

cards.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365
cards.description: Microsoft finance, operations and customer engagement. Bring ERP, CRM and business intelligence together, with applications aligned to your organisation’s needs.

cards.title: Odoo
cards.description: An agile platform for growing firms. Odoo’s modular structure supports customisable, cost-effective solutions across CRM, inventory, accounting and sales.

cards.title: Zoho
cards.description: Agile ERP and CRM for growing firms. Connect operational processes with Zoho customer journeys and a Customer 360 approach.

cards.title: Salesforce
cards.description: Elevate customer engagement and streamline operations. Align Salesforce CRM with your business goals through consulting, implementation, integration, migration and support.

cards.title: Platform migration & AMS
cards.description: Implementation, upgrades and migration, followed by managed support and optimisation. SAP migration accelerators, regression packs and intelligent ops support the journey.

sections.heading: A composable platform *where ERP and CRM do not fit*

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: A flexible, composable platform for customised ERP, CRM and complex business applications, offering a scalable alternative to traditional enterprise systems with cyber-safe delivery.
